lines.en: label kaoricamp1:
scene kaorianotherhunt1
: Friendburger! You have returnedburger! Did you forget to rub Frog Boy for good luck?
lines.zh: : 朋友堡！你回来堡了！你是不是忘了摸青蛙男孩求好运？

lines.en: : Yup. That’s exactly why I came back. You know me so well, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 对。我就是为这个回来的。你太了解我了，Kaori。

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt2
: I could not call myself a friend if I did not understand when you desired the rubbing of a special frog. All in a day’s job.
lines.zh: : 如果我看不出你想要摸一只特别的青蛙，我就不配称作朋友。这都是分内之事。

lines.en: : Go on, Friend. Rub the Frog Boy and carry on with your tree-based day of resting. Nao-chan and I have much job to do and have not included your mouthwords in our daily time budget.
lines.zh: : 去吧，朋友。摸一摸青蛙男孩，然后继续你那树里的休息日。我和 Nao 酱有很多工作要做，而我们每天的时间预算里并没有把你的嘴巴话算进去。

lines.en: : Well, what are you two doing exactly? Maybe I can tag along.
lines.zh: : 那么，你们俩到底在做什么？也许我可以跟着一起。

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt3
: A long what?
lines.zh: : 一个长长（a long）的什么？

lines.en: : No, Nao-chan. Friend wants to play tag because he is larger than us and knows he can win. It is in periods like this where we must decide against bending as we are not pipe cleaners with human parts. Right, Friend?
lines.zh: : 不，Nao 酱。朋友想玩的是「抓人（tag）」，因为他比我们大，而且知道自己稳赢。在这种时刻，我们必须决定不弯下腰，因为我们不是长着人类部件的管道清洁刷。对吧，朋友？

lines.en: : Sure. But you still haven’t told me what you’re doing.
lines.zh: : 对。不过你还是没告诉我在做什么。

lines.en: : Do you not have the job to do?
lines.zh: : 你没有工作要做吗？

lines.en: : The only {i}job{/i} I came here with was making sure my niece isn’t entirely miserable all day. But I think I’ve already failed that as she’s been kidnapped by Sara.
lines.zh: : 我来这儿唯一的{i}工作{/i}，就是确保我侄女一整天不至于太惨。不过我想我已经失败了，因为她被 Sara 绑走了。

lines.en: : The Sara is here too? I do not have time to serve dizzy drinks to customers today. Especially customers in the tree village as those customers are animals and can not consume most human beverages.
lines.zh: : 那个 Sara 也在这儿？我今天可没时间给顾客上晕眩饮料。尤其是树村里的顾客 —— 那些顾客都是动物，喝不了大多数人类饮料。

lines.en: : Don’t worry. Sara has the day off and I won’t let her know you’re here. But what are you so busy with anyway? I figured you two would be enjoying a rare day off or something.
lines.zh: : 别担心。Sara 今天休息，我不会让她知道你在这儿。不过你们到底在忙什么？我还以为你们俩会难得地享受一天假期什么的。

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt4
: Exactly!
lines.zh: : 正是！

lines.en: : I can’t consistently speak Nao’s silent language yet, Kaori. Please translate.
lines.zh: : 我还不能稳定地读懂 Nao 的沉默语言，Kaori。请翻译一下。

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt5
: Nao-chan says that you can still enjoy the workless work day while working!
lines.zh: : Nao 酱说，你可以一边工作，一边享受这个不工作的工作日！

lines.en: : But then it wouldn’t-
lines.zh: : 可那样它就不——

lines.en: : Do not search for answers, Friend! It is the question that truly matters!
lines.zh: : 别去找答案，朋友！真正重要的是问题！

lines.en: : Is there confusion in your head-house?
lines.zh: : 你的脑袋房子里有困惑吗？

lines.en: : There’s a lot in my head-house and confusion is only one of the inhabitants. I still don’t know what you’re doing, though.
lines.zh: : 我的脑袋房子里住了不少东西，困惑只是其中一个房客。不过我还是不知道你在做什么。

lines.en: : Do you recall the flattened tree corpse that eventually led to our discovery of Nao-chan in the beginning place?
lines.zh: : 你还记得那片压平的树尸吗？它最终让我们在最初的地方发现了 Nao 酱。

lines.en: : The...treasure map thing that was taped to your door?
lines.zh: : 那个……贴在你门上的藏宝图？

lines.en: : Correct. The flattened tree corpse. I have received another one.
lines.zh: : 没错。那片压平的树尸。我又收到了一张。

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt6
: Does it have more than just a symbol written on it this time?
lines.zh: : 这次上面不只有一个符号了吧？

lines.en: : There were no words and no symbols written on this one. But that is okay for I already understand where I am supposed to go!
lines.zh: : 这张上面既没有字，也没有符号。但没关系，因为我已经知道我该去哪儿了！

lines.en: : {i}How?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}怎么知道的？{/i}

lines.en: : Because nothingness is Nao-chan’s language and she was able to draw a picture of the location we must return to! How convenient it is to know a human who can out-human other humans!
lines.zh: : 因为「无」就是 Nao 酱的语言，而她画出了我们必须回去的那个地方的图画！认识一个能比其他人类更像人类的人类，真是太方便了！

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt7
: So...you two came all the way out here because you got a blank sheet of paper and interpreted it as a treasure map to something located in a remote forest?
lines.zh: : 所以……你们两个大老远跑到这里，就因为收到一张白纸，然后把它当成了一张指向某片偏僻森林里某样东西的藏宝图？

lines.en: : That is not incorrect.
lines.zh: : 这不算错。

lines.en: : Did Nao at least tell you what the treasure {i}is?{/i}
lines.zh: : Nao 至少告诉你们宝藏{i}是{/i}什么了吧？

lines.en: : We believe the treasure is the material or materials we require to build a special machine that will help us better understand human emotions!
lines.zh: : 我们相信，宝藏就是我们建造一台特殊机器所需要的那种或那些材料 —— 那台机器能帮我们更好地理解人类的情感！

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 我明白了……

lines.en: I don’t actually see. But that’s probably not something I have to directly inform you of since you’ve likely experienced enough secondhand Kaori to know that nothing she does make sense.
lines.zh: 其实我一点也没明白。不过这大概也不用我直接告诉你，因为你多半已经间接经历了足够多的 Kaori，知道她做的任何事都不讲道理。

lines.en: And, while I’m not sure if I want to assist her on another wild goose chase that could potentially result in one more kidnapping, I’ve gotta say-
lines.zh: 而且，虽然我不确定自己想不想再陪她来一场可能又导致一次绑架的徒劳追逐，但我得说——

lines.en: I’m intrigued by what the colors of the eyes on this one would be.
lines.zh: 我对「这一位」眼睛的颜色会是什么样很感兴趣。

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt8
stop kidding yourself. you know you just want one to keep as a souvenir since spider girl gets to have this one all to herself.
{s}but there is no one here and no one for me to keep as a souvenir and you are wrong parold dolia you are very very wrong{/s}
lines.zh: {s}可是这里一个人也没有 也没有人能让我留作纪念 而你错了 parold dolia 你非常非常错{/s}

lines.en: things still exist here. you’ve just stopped seeing them for now. the same way you stopped seeing macaroni girl for a little while before she went poof.
lines.zh: 这里的东西依然存在 你只是暂时看不见它们了 就像你有段时间也看不见那个通心粉女孩 在她噗地消失之前

lines.en: {s}could this mean that there is still macaroni left over{/s}
lines.zh: {s}这是不是说 还剩下了一些通心粉{/s}

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt9
{b}how about a macaron instead{/b}
lines.zh: {b}那要不要换成马卡龙{/b}

lines.en: it is my favorite
lines.zh: 那是我的最爱

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt6
: Did the macarons happen?
lines.zh: : 马卡龙出现了吗？

lines.en: : How do you know about the-
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道——

lines.en: : Nao-chan informed me of something known as “macaron time” that happens when a brain gets less brainy than a brain is meant to brain.
lines.zh: : Nao 酱告诉了我一个叫做「马卡龙时间」的东西，它会在一个脑子变得比它本该有的脑程度更不脑的时候发生。

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt10
: Don’t just give me a thumbs up when you should be chasing after your frog. And how do you know what’s going on inside of my head?
lines.zh: : 你该去追你的青蛙的时候，别只给我竖个大拇指。还有，你怎么知道我脑子里在想什么？

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt11
: Maybe it is because she also has a head? Humans need heads or they will be headless like Michael.
lines.zh: : 也许是因为她也有一个头？人类需要头，不然就会像 Michael 一样没有头。

lines.en: : I have no idea who that-
lines.zh: : 我完全不知道那是谁——

lines.en: : Yes you do. Will you come along for the hunt of the treasure supplies, Friend? Maybe there will be macarons there and you will not have to battle hunger any longer?
lines.zh: : 你知道的。你要一起来找造宝藏的材料吗，朋友？也许那里会有马卡龙，你就再也不用和饥饿作战了？

lines.en: : {s}Wait. I’m not ready to-{/s} Sure.
lines.zh: : {s}等等。我还没准备好——{/s}好吧。

lines.en: menu:
engage macaron time
lines.zh: 启动马卡龙时间

lines.en: scene macaron1
scene macaron2
scene macaron3
scene macaron5
scene kaorianotherhunt12
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : The movement of the earth-breath suggests that we are in the right location, but I see no supplies other than grass or snailbugs. And they will not help us make the machine.
lines.zh: : 大地之气的流动表明我们来对了地方，可除了草和蜗牛虫，我什么材料都没看见。而它们可帮不了我们造机器。

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt13
: Have we been here before? This place seems familiar.
lines.zh: : 我们以前来过这儿吗？这地方看着挺眼熟。

lines.en: : This is the twin of the first forest. It’s where the treasure is meant to be kept, but no treasure can ever be found. What do you suggest we do next, Nao-chan?
lines.zh: : 这是第一片森林的孪生兄弟。宝藏本该藏在这里，可从来没有人找到过。你建议我们接下来怎么做，Nao 酱？

lines.en: : I think your suggestion is good. But I am worried of what will happen to you if you walk away from the line that helps me see things.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你的建议不错。但我担心，如果你离开了那根能让我看见东西的线，你会出事。

lines.en: : It is true that Friend is here to help. But friend can only hold what he’s allowed to. His arms become weak when he’s forced to carry things he can not fit beneath his bed-box.
lines.zh: : 朋友确实是来帮忙的。但朋友只能拿他被允许拿的东西。要是被迫去搬那些塞不进他床箱底下的东西，他的手臂就会变得无力。

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt14
: Wait! Nao-chan!
lines.zh: : 等等！Nao 酱！

lines.en: : She’s an arguably otherworldly being. I’m sure she’ll be able to find her way back, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 她可以说是个超凡脱俗的存在。我敢肯定她能找到回来的路，Kaori。

lines.en: : But there is the possibility that she will encounter a furry enemy rather than a furry friend! A hungry bear could turn Nao-chan into No-chan! Or Nothing-chan! Or Food-chan!
lines.zh: : 可她也有可能遇到的不是毛茸茸的朋友，而是毛茸茸的敌人！一头饿熊可能会把 Nao 酱变成「不」酱！或者「什么都没有」酱！或者「食物」酱！

lines.en: : So could John and you keep him in your apartment.
lines.zh: : John 也能做到，而你还把他养在公寓里。

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt15
: John has begun to shrink as some of his great chicken powers are now being distributed to Frog Boy, human frog. Nao-chan is no longer in any danger of becoming chicken food.
lines.zh: : John 开始缩小了，因为他的一些伟大鸡力现在被分配给了青蛙男孩 —— 人类青蛙。Nao 酱再也不会有变成鸡饲料的危险了。

lines.en: : Well that’s good. It means we only have to worry about her frog becoming gigantic next and then eating {i}everything{/i} because that is what frogs do.
lines.zh: : 那挺好的。这意味着我们只需要担心她的青蛙接下来变得巨大、然后把{i}所有东西{/i}都吃掉 —— 因为青蛙就是这么干活的。

lines.en: : Frog Boy is one of the good guys. He will protect us from the darkness and join us in the color machine.
lines.zh: : 青蛙男孩是好人那边的。他会保护我们免受黑暗侵袭，还会和我们一起进入颜色机器。

lines.en: : Color machine? Is that the thing you were talking about that will help you {i}better understand human emotions{/i} or whatever?
lines.zh: : 颜色机器？就是你刚才说的那个能帮你们{i}更好地理解人类情感{/i}之类的东西？

lines.en: : Of course, Friend. That is what colors are — symbols and icons of what we feel or think. We all have them, and sometimes they change. But sometimes they don’t.
lines.zh: : 当然，朋友。颜色就是这样的东西 —— 我们的感受和想法的符号与图标。我们每个人都有，而且它们有时会变。但有时不会。

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt16
: You were clear when we first met, Friend. But you are much darker now. Which means that something must have changed in your living-life.
lines.zh: : 我们初遇时你是透明的，朋友。可你现在暗多了。这说明你活着的人生里一定有什么东西变了。

lines.en: : Did a cloud of sadness sneak into your mouth when our tongues touched?
lines.zh: : 是我们的舌头碰在一起的时候，有一朵悲伤的云偷偷溜进你嘴里了吗？

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt17
: No, Kaori. A cloud of sadness did not sneak into my mouth when our tongues touched. I’ve just been so busy hating myself lately that my {i}clear{/i} aura must be decaying from lack of proper care.
lines.zh: : 没有，Kaori。我们的舌头碰在一起的时候，没有什么悲伤的云溜进我嘴里。我只是最近忙着恨自己，{i}透明{/i}的光环大概是疏于照料、开始腐坏了。

lines.en: : Like a frog!
lines.zh: : 就像青蛙！

lines.en: : Sure. Exactly like a frog.
lines.zh: : 对。就像青蛙一样。

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt18
: {i}Do you have a favorite thing about frogs, Friend? Do you know why I gave one to Nao-chan?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你最喜欢青蛙的哪一点，朋友？你知道我为什么送了一只给 Nao 酱吗？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I do not. To both of those questions.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}两个问题我都不知道。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}The best frog fact is how they can turn themselves off in the winter! The wood frog can freeze two thirds of its body and it makes a special slime that protects its body from the cold.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}关于青蛙最棒的知识，就是它们能在冬天把自己关掉！林蛙可以把身体的三分之二冻住，还会分泌一种特殊的黏液来保护身体不受寒冷伤害。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}And that’s why you got one for Nao? So she could use its natural oils to...lubricate herself?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}所以你才给 Nao 买了一只？好让她用它的天然油脂来……润滑自己？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Incorrectamundo! Frog Boy is Nao-chan’s frog boy because she must learn responsibility and Frog Boy is strong enough to exist without her!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}大错特错！青蛙男孩之所以是 Nao 酱的青蛙男孩，是因为她必须学会负责任，而青蛙男孩足够坚强，没有她也能活下去！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}As Nao-chan’s mothermom, it is my responsibility to make her know what responsibility is. So she has a frog now so she can try to be responsible but can make mistakes since Frog Boy is strong.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}作为 Nao 酱的妈妈，让她明白什么是责任是我的责任。所以她现在有了一只青蛙，这样她可以尝试负责任，也可以犯错 —— 因为青蛙男孩很强壮。{/i}

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt19
: Even as a child frog, Frog Boy can still protect himself when the hot turns to cold without anyone’s help at all.
lines.zh: : 就算还是只小青蛙，当热变成冷的时候，青蛙男孩也能在没有任何人帮忙的情况下保护自己。

lines.en: : But if you leave a human out in the cold, it will freeze and unalive. Which is why you must give small humans a blanket.
lines.zh: : 可如果你把一个人留在寒冷里，他会冻僵、然后不再活着。所以你必须给小小人类一条毯子。

lines.en: : I think I get what you’re saying. And I don’t think it’s a bad idea. But, at the same time, if Nao makes mistakes, which she will since she’s so young, won’t her actions changing the frog’s “color” upset you?
lines.zh: : 我想我明白你的意思了。而且我不觉得这主意不好。但与此同时，如果 Nao 犯了错 —— 她那么小，肯定会犯 —— 她的行为改变了青蛙的「颜色」，你不会难过吗？

lines.en: : If I’ve become “darker” lately because I haven’t been taking care of myself, I don’t want the change in Frog Boy’s tone upsetting either of you.
lines.zh: : 如果我是因为不好好照顾自己才最近变「暗」的，那我可不希望青蛙男孩色调的变化让你们俩难过。

lines.en: : You may believe your color has changed because you are not taking the cares for yourself, Friend — but that is your thought alone!
lines.zh: : 你也许以为自己的颜色变了，是因为你没有好好照顾自己，朋友 —— 但那只是你自己的想法！

lines.en: : Do you think it’s something else?
lines.zh: : 你觉得是别的原因？

lines.en: : I think you are just cold because no one ever gave you a blanket. You are not Frog Boy. You can not freeze two thirds of your body when the heat isn’t hot anymore.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你只是冷，因为从来没有人给过你一条毯子。你不是青蛙男孩。热度不再热的时候，你没法把身体的三分之二冻起来。

lines.en: : So what you’re saying is...my color has been destined to change from the start since no one ever gave me a blanket?
lines.zh: : 所以你的意思是……我的颜色从一开始注定要变，因为从来没有人给过我一条毯子？

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt20
: I never met the small you. But the big you is a good you. So I can’t say whether or not the you that isn’t you anymore is the color it was destined to be.
lines.zh: : 我从来没见过小小的你。但大大的你是个好的你。所以我说不准，那个已经不再是你的你，是不是它注定要成为的颜色。

lines.en: : But maybe the you that is inside of you is?
lines.zh: : 但也许在你里面的那个你是呢？

lines.en: : There is no “me inside of me,” Kaori.
lines.zh: : 没有什么「在我里面的我」，Kaori。

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt21
: Sure there is.
lines.zh: : 当然有。

lines.en: : If there is a me inside of me, there must be a you inside of you. It’s the only thing that makes sense.
lines.zh: : 如果有一个我在我里面，那就一定有一个你 在你里面。这是唯一说得通的事。

lines.en: : For example — my outside color is green, but my inside color is red because the other me is a different me.
lines.zh: : 比如说 —— 我外面的颜色是绿色，但我里面的颜色是红色，因为另一个我是不同的我。

lines.en: : Sure. But I also haven’t ruled out the possibility that you’re literally just possessed after you threw yourself at me outside of your apartment. So maybe that “you inside of you” isn’t actually {i}you{/i} at all?
lines.zh: : 对。不过我也没有排除这种可能 —— {i}你{/i}在公寓外面扑向我之后，其实就只是被附身了。所以那个「你里面的你」也许根本不是你？

lines.en: : I am confused. Please explain that to me in simpler human terms.
lines.zh: : 我糊涂了。请用更简单的人类语言给我解释一下。

lines.en: : Your explanation was worded the same exact way, so don’t go pretending you don’t know what I’m talking about, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 你的解释用的措辞一模一样，所以别装作不知道我在说什么，Kaori。

lines.en: : All of this shit with colors and how I’m {i}darker{/i} now has nothing to do with the way I was brought up or growing up without a blanket. I’m darker now because I’ve lost the only thing keeping me sane.
lines.zh: : 这些关于颜色、关于我现在{i}变暗{/i}了的事，和我被怎样养大、或者从小没有毯子毫无关系。我现在变暗，是因为我失去了唯一能让我保持清醒的东西。

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt22
: And you are out of sane now?
lines.zh: : 那你现在已经不清醒了？

lines.en: : I’m {i}sad.{/i} I’m {i}lonely.{/i} And I’m here to try and start over, but I can’t even do {i}that{/i} because the girl who will be the key to it is currently getting a makeover in a tent I’m not allowed to enter.
lines.zh: : 我{i}难过{/i}。我{i}孤独{/i}。我来这儿是想重新开始，可我连{i}这个{/i}都做不到，因为那个将成为关键的女孩，此刻正在一个我不准进去的帐篷里改头换面。

lines.en: : How do you know that the human female you are referencing is the key?
lines.zh: : 你怎么知道你说的那个女性人类就是关键？

lines.en: : Deductive reasoning, I guess? She’s the one thing tying each terrible bit of my past together. And I’ve failed her so many times that, at this rate, she’ll be the next thing I lose.
lines.zh: : 大概是演绎推理？她是唯一一个把我过去每一段糟糕经历串起来的东西。而我辜负了她那么多次，照这样下去，她会是我下一个失去的东西。

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt23
: This line of human-thinking is very sad, Friend. Yours will be the first I fix when I create the color machine. But until then, I do not know if I will be able to understand the way you think.
lines.zh: : 这条人类思路非常悲伤，朋友。等我造出颜色机器，你的会是第一个修好的。但在那之前，我不知道自己能不能理解你的想法。

lines.en: : And I don’t blame you for that. It’s complicated. But I’m glad you’re at least...thinking about me, I guess.
lines.zh: : 这一点我不怪你。这很复杂。不过我很高兴你至少……会想着我，大概吧。

lines.en: : I am almost always thinking about you, Friend. Especially now that there’s an extra me inside of me.
lines.zh: : 我几乎无时无刻不在想着你，朋友。尤其是现在，我里面多了一个我。

lines.en: : Does that make you sad as well?
lines.zh: : 这也让你难过吗？

lines.en: : Not sad, no.
lines.zh: : 不难过，不算。

lines.en: : Just a little uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 只是有点不自在。

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt22
: Uncomfortable?
lines.zh: : 不自在？

lines.en: : That “other you” reminds me of someone.
lines.zh: : 那个「另一个你」让我想起某个人。

lines.en: : Someone you dislike?
lines.zh: : 你不喜欢的人？

lines.en: : Yes.
: But also no.
lines.zh: : 也不是。

lines.en: : Again, it’s complicated.
lines.zh: : 再说一次，这很复杂。

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt24
: This is why we must create the color machine!
lines.zh: : 所以我们必须造出颜色机器！

lines.en: : The corpsemap would not lead me astray! And there are so many special metals beneath the ground! They must be unearthed before night falls and the sun goes to sleep!
lines.zh: : 尸体地图不会把我引错路的！而且地下有那么多特别的金属！必须在夜幕降临、太阳去睡觉之前把它们挖出来！

lines.en: : Kaori, I know I came out here to help you, but I really don’t want to start digging up random minerals from the ground on what’s supposed to be a day of rest for me.
lines.zh: : Kaori，我知道我出来是想帮你，但我真的不想在本该休息的日子里，开始从地里乱挖矿物。

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt25
: That is okay. I will kill the dirt myself.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我自己来杀这些土。

lines.en: : Where did you even get that?
lines.zh: : 你那玩意儿到底从哪儿弄来的？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt26
: Since you are an assistant to the treasure hunter and not a real treasure hunter yourself, perhaps you could play a one-sided game of seek and hide and discover where Nao-chan ran off to?
lines.zh: : 既然你是寻宝者的助手，而不是真正的寻宝者，也许你可以玩一个单方面的捉迷藏，去找找 Nao 酱跑到哪儿去了？

lines.en: : I’m very worried about her. She has seemed eager to explore the tree village since the moment we arrived.
lines.zh: : 我很担心她。从我们到的那一刻起，她就一直很想去探索树村。

lines.en: : Sure, but...come to think of it, how did you two get here in the first place? You don’t drive.
lines.zh: : 好啊，不过……话说回来，你们俩到底是怎么到这儿来的？你又不会开车。

lines.en: scene kaorianotherhunt27
: The same way I go to and from my many jobs, Friend.
lines.zh: : 和我往返那么多份工作的方式一样，朋友。

lines.en: : Which is?
lines.zh: : 那是什么方式？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: scene sky
: Okay. Forget it. I’ll go look for Nao.
lines.zh: : 好吧。算了。我去找 Nao。

lines.en: : Thank you, Friend!
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，朋友！

lines.en: : Oh! And please tell Nao-chan to bring back dinner for Frog Boy in case her memory is not properly functioning! There are worms near the water! Offspring of the contaminant!
lines.zh: : 哦！还有，请告诉 Nao 酱，让她给青蛙男孩带晚饭回来，万一她的记忆功能不太正常呢！水边有虫子！是污染的后代！

lines.en: : I’ll be sure to do that, Kaori.
lines.zh: : 我一定转告她，Kaori。

lines.en: scene black
I leave Kaori to her own devices or...whichever devices she plans on creating after unearthing “mysterious metals” from the forest floor and think more about what she said about colors.
lines.zh: 我让 Kaori 自生自灭 —— 或者说，让她去折腾从林地里挖出「神秘金属」之后打算造出来的随便什么装置 —— 然后更多地思考她说的关于颜色的话。

lines.en: If even she’s noticed a change in my demeanor, it must be pretty apparent. Which, granted, I sort of expected. And that’s only beaten into me harder by the fact that {i}everyone’s{/i} been noticing it.
lines.zh: 如果连她都注意到我状态变了，那一定很明显了。当然，这我多少预料到了。而{i}所有人{/i}都注意到了这一点，更是把这件事硬生生敲进我脑子里。

lines.en: But I kind of hoped she’d be an exception.
lines.zh: 可我有点希望她是个例外。

lines.en: So long as there’s an extra “her” inside of her, though...I doubt that’ll change.
lines.zh: 不过只要她里面还有一个「她」……我怀疑这事不会变。

lines.en: And I doubt I’ll be able to peel myself out of her mind either.
lines.zh: 我也怀疑自己能不能从她的脑子里把自己剥出来。

lines.en: But...maybe that’s good.
lines.zh: 不过……也许那是好事。

lines.en: Maybe I can expect more of whatever that borderline sexual assault shit was from a while back.
lines.zh: 也许我可以期待更多那种「近乎性侵」的破事，就像前阵子那样。

lines.en: I mean, I’ve been borderline sexual assaulting tons of girls over the last few school years, so it’s only fair if more people start taking advantage of me too, right?
lines.zh: 我是说，过去几个学年我一直在「近乎性侵」一大堆女孩，所以如果更多人开始反过来占我便宜，也很公平，对吧？

lines.en: In fact, my assaults haven’t been borderline at all. They’ve just been assaults.
lines.zh: 事实上，我的那些侵犯根本算不上「近乎」。那就是侵犯。

lines.en: I’ve been doing terrible things and you’ve been watching me doing terrible things, but now that things are starting to get more terrible, it’s getting harder to convince yourself that other stuff wasn’t or isn’t terrible.
lines.zh: 我一直在做可怕的事，而你一直在看着我做可怕的事，可现在事情开始变得更可怕了，你就越来越难说服自己 —— 那些别的事过去不可怕、现在也不可怕。

lines.en: Right?
lines.zh: 对吧？

lines.en: Isn’t that right?
lines.zh: 难道不是吗？

lines.en: Anyway, I’m in the forest now.
lines.zh: 总之，我现在在森林里。

lines.en: I’m in the forest now and I’m looking for someone.
lines.zh: 我现在在森林里，正在找一个人。

$ kaori_love += 1
